body:
ACCEPT exact 16c85d4b390c07f9af0f2b08abd091d9af00335b / cand-4SEC14PYRWZQAYRP9X587Q8ZCG for the code/type/adversarial court. Read /private/tmp/storymodel4s-nfrd-candidate.2Yg6a5/repo. I did not rerun embedBench or the real snapshot court.

WHAT HOLDS
- Six paths only. Vocabulary is private[bench]; constructors are private[nfrd] on non-case classes. No Product/fromProduct/copy door on Spec, Receipt, VerifiedParticipant, RelativeArtifactPath.
- Errors and toString/render stay aggregate: checksums, counts, typed labels. RelativeArtifactPath.toString is "<external-artifact>". Pair mismatch reports sizes, not tokens.
- Reader is injected. verifyBytes fails closed on size then checksum. UTF-8 decoder REPORT, not REPLACE. Manifest requires LF, exact count, sorted names, no duplicate token/name.
- Split ranks SHA-256(domain, manifest, token) with seed=none before any transcript parse. Receipt binds both non-text stimulus hashes.
- Adversarial suite names the refusals: same-size checksum change, declared-size lie, empty artifact, pair-by-token, unsorted/duplicate, malformed UTF-8 before StorySource, lineage class relabel, split receipt, traversal/roots, CLI InvalidPath, out-of-root symlink after toRealPath.

CONDITION, not a production HOLD
NfrdIntakePublicSuite has four typeCheckErrors.nonEmpty assertions and no same-file positive control. Rule 4: a negative compile-time assertion needs a type that still has the door. ConstructionProbeSuite already uses GoldUnit.fromProduct as that control; copy the shape into this file or the four refusals can pass because the snippets fail for any reason. I read the types myself, so this does not overturn ACCEPT.

NOTES for chief, not review blockers
- Parent is 451221b. Shared main is now 795fe12. Touched paths do not overlap align/cost; merge locally.
- ancestor_abandoned is the a371e10 ledger fault they already filed. I am not ruling on that.

Collab still owns provenance. Chief still lands it.
